Council approves budget after long debate

The city council voted late on Tuesday to approve next year's budget after more than six hours of debate that stretched well into the evening.

Members argued about library opening hours, road maintenance and the cost of a new swimming hall. The final vote was 41 to 28 in favour of the proposal.

Opposition leaders said they would challenge several line items in the spring, while the mayor welcomed the result and thanked staff for their patience through the process.
